subject: Money
title: Digital Services Tax
description: A 60-second lesson on Digital Services Tax.

hook.text: Google earns billions from French users but reports minimal profit in France. Where should it pay tax?

buildup.text: Digital companies can serve a country without a physical presence. Old tax rules need a factory or office.

discovery.text: France imposed a 3% tax on digital revenue in 2019. The U.K., Italy, and India followed with similar laws.

twist.text: The U.S. called these taxes discriminatory against American tech companies and threatened tariffs.

climax.text: Taxing digital giants requires global agreement. Without it, countries will keep fighting over the revenue.

punchline.text: The internet has no borders. Tax law does.

quiz.question: Why are digital services taxes controversial?
options: They mainly target U.S. tech companies
